prompt:
Compose a short message explaining that a shared document is ready for factual corrections, but that major changes to its structure will be considered separately. Please answer in roughly 160 words.

Write the requested response as one self-contained paragraph of plain text. Do not use a title, headings, bullet points, numbered lists, Markdown formatting, code fences, or line breaks. Include only the requested content, without any introductory or closing commentary from the assistant. Keep the approximate word target given in the task. If the task calls for an email, dialogue, steps, or calculations, express that content within the same paragraph.
base_prompt: Compose a short message explaining that a shared document is ready for factual corrections, but that major changes to its structure will be considered separately. Please answer in roughly 160 words.
text: The shared document is now ready for a factual review. Please use this round to flag inaccuracies, outdated information, missing context that affects accuracy, or statements that need a source or clarification. Where possible, suggest a specific correction and include a supporting reference so we can resolve comments efficiently. The aim is to make sure the content is reliable and reflects the facts before we move forward. Larger proposals, such as reorganizing sections, changing the overall narrative, or substantially expanding or reducing the scope, will be considered separately rather than incorporated during this review. Those suggestions are welcome, but please label them clearly as structural feedback so they can be collected for a dedicated discussion. Keeping the two types of feedback separate will help us address factual issues promptly while giving broader changes the attention they deserve. Thank you for helping strengthen the document and for keeping this review focused on accuracy, clarity, and any essential corrections to the existing content.
